definitions: A member of the United States Marine Corps, a branch of the United States Armed Forces responsible for providing power projection from the sea, utilizing the mobility of the U.S. Navy to deliver rapidly deployable task forces.
An enlisted person or officer in the U.S. Marine Corps.
examples: He served as a United States Marine for four years.
Every United States Marine is trained to be a formidable fighter.
The United States Marine stood guard at the embassy.
